notes:
Inbound from founder (Lina Park) — small K12 tutoring app. Wants lightweight classroom copilot + content moderation for student submissions. Budget constraints: says "we're early revenue, want $/student < $1/month". Key points:
- current stack: Heroku + Postgres, simple React web app
- usage pattern: spikes at 4–8pm, avg 1000 prompts/day initial, target 10k in 6mo
- latency sensitivity: chat responses < 1.5s preferred for quick classroom flow but can accept 2.5s during peaks
- cost sensitivity: looking for batching/caching guidance, prefer hosted API to avoid infra ops
- moderation: must flag/auto-remove harmful content; false positives are a big UX risk for teachers
- security: needs SSO/SAML for teacher accounts; requests SOC2 report & basic audit logs; no strict data residency requirement (NA ok)
- quote from call: "We need something that just works and doesn't break students' flow — price matters more than razor-low latency right now."
POC asks: 30-day hosted trial, sample moderation policy, recommended model/quant profiles for budget. AE notes: good fit for Hosted API; convert to demo if budget conversation goes well.
